public_rationale: The evidence includes substantial progress, including human-surpassing action efficiency on one benchmark. That benchmark's authors expressly decline to equate its results with AGI. Neither these gains nor remaining limitations settle whether LLM-based systems can eventually achieve human-level general intelligence. Marcus supplied no deadline.
limitations: AGI and the architectural boundary are not precisely defined.
Benchmark success is narrower than general intelligence; present shortcomings do not establish permanent inability.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Large language models like ChatGPT will not get us to AGI.

statement.excerpt: I just don’t happen to think large language models like ChatGPT will get us there.
statement.document_title: Three years on, ChatGPT still isn't what it was cracked up to be – and it probably never will be

our_interpretation: The plain reading is that LLM-based systems will not achieve the breadth and resourcefulness of human intelligence.
Ordinary tools and additional training do not automatically put a system outside the claim. A fundamentally different source of its general intelligence could.
Human-level general intelligence does not require infallibility. Independent evidence of broad, adaptable competence is required; a product announcement or one benchmark is insufficient.
criteria.support_condition: A validated result establishing that the relevant class of LLM-based systems cannot achieve human-level general intelligence. Continued failure over a finite period cannot establish this indefinite negative.
criteria.contradiction_condition: An LLM-based system demonstrably achieves human-level breadth and resourcefulness, with independent confirmation and sufficient architectural information to establish that it falls within the claim.

evidence.explanation: This is material evidence of progress against human performance. The evaluator nevertheless says the benchmark's bounded environments do not establish AGI, so it does not meet the early-resolution rule.

OpenAI reports advances across several domains. This is relevant counterevidence to pessimism about the approach, but the announcement does not independently establish human-level general intelligence.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: Independent, broad validation of AGI in an in-scope LLM-based system, or a validated impossibility result that actually covers the claimed systems and capability.
